criteria.text: First acceptance contract/failing rendered test rejecting only sessions.profiles, proving seven rows, MCP opens, profile alert visible; trace never reports success count for rejected call and honestly states failure.

Any one or all four load calls failing leaves all seven section rows rendered/selectable and keyboard accessible; Runtime/OpenCode server, Behavior and Keybindings remain reachable offline; ListInspector fatal error remains reserved/documented/tested for an unbuildable list.
Accounts/MCP/provider/profile each get section-local retry that calls only that request.
Per-section retrying/status; aria-disabled+guard, aria-busy, local role=status; sibling sections stay enabled and duplicate activation counts remain one.
Per-section generation/newest-started wins across load, retry and action reloads; load run generation prevents StrictMode/older Refresh overwrite, including delayed/out-of-order responses.
Focus stays on failing button or moves to persistent status after success; axe in states; desktop+narrow screenshots/overflow and 44px scoped button CSS.
Provider badges: unknown on initial failure, Last known on stale refresh failure, confirmed Connected/Not connected only after successful current read; needs-relogin only confirmed disconnected.
Split accounts/mcp load errors from mutation errors; action failures have no load Retry and exact retry labels remain.
One readSection owner for per-section generation/pending/status across load/retry/action; newer reads clear contradictory retry status for all four sections and action reloads.
A retry superseded by Refresh cannot leave a busy guard or allow stale response to update status/error/data, across all four sections.
Retry focus moves only if still on its origin or body after origin unmount; no setTimeout or focus theft after user moves, across all four sections.
checkProviderAuth ignores stale success and failure after a newer provider read, without contradicting its badge or dismissing its flow.
Unread provider badges display exact Status unknown without capitalization; detail headings are h3 with unchanged visual size.
